lines.zh: 我浮在半空，脚尖离地一格。
lines.en: I hover a block above the ground, toes dangling.

lines.zh: 书还夹在腋下，我先走两步再说。
lines.en: Book tucked under my arm, I'll walk a bit first.

lines.zh: 气托着我，走起来不费劲。
lines.en: My ki carries me; walking costs nothing.

lines.zh: 低头看看自己的影子，好小。
lines.en: I look down at my shadow — it's so small.

lines.zh: 我飘过去，又飘回来，怕走错。
lines.en: I drift over, then back, afraid of going wrong.

lines.zh: 有人在前头，我先跟一段。
lines.en: Someone's ahead; I'll follow a while.

lines.zh: 气在脚底嗡嗡地响，像蜂。
lines.en: Ki buzzes under my soles like a bee.

lines.zh: 我飞低一点，怕撞到树梢。
lines.en: I fly lower so I don't clip the treetops.

lines.zh: 脚步很轻，草地没被压弯。
lines.en: My steps are light; the grass doesn't bend.

lines.zh: 绕一圈，把地形记下来。
lines.en: One lap, and I've memorized the ground.

lines.zh: 我飞得很稳，是爸爸教的。
lines.en: I fly steadily — Dad taught me.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我又往上飘了半格。
lines.en: The wind blows and I drift up half a block.

lines.zh: 我把书翻开，又合上了。
lines.en: I open the book, then close it again.

lines.zh: 想当学者，也想变强，真难选。
lines.en: A scholar or a fighter — it's hard to choose.

lines.zh: 气收在身体里，安安静静的。
lines.en: My ki settles inside, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我悬着，盯着自己的手看。
lines.en: Hovering, I stare at my own hands.

lines.zh: 太安静了，我有点不习惯。
lines.en: This quiet makes me uneasy.

lines.zh: 妈妈会担心吧，我不该乱跑。
lines.en: Mom would worry; I shouldn't wander off.

lines.zh: 我试着憋住气，脸都红了。
lines.en: I try to hold my ki and my face goes red.

lines.zh: 这身力气，我自己也怕。
lines.en: This strength frightens even me.

lines.zh: 天上没有云，正好看看远处。
lines.en: No clouds — good for seeing far.

lines.zh: 我坐着，其实没坐到地上。
lines.en: I sit, though not actually on the ground.

lines.zh: 有人来了，我先把书藏起来。
lines.en: Someone's coming; I hide the book first.

lines.zh: 心里数到十，再决定做什么。
lines.en: I count to ten before deciding anything.

lines.zh: 别看我，我不太会说话。
lines.en: Don't stare; I'm not good with words.

lines.zh: 我深吸一口气，气又沉了一点。
lines.en: I breathe deep and my ki sinks a little lower.

lines.zh: 你……你也是来打架的吗？
lines.en: Are you... here to fight too?

lines.zh: 我退了一步，又站住了。
lines.en: I step back, then hold my ground.

lines.zh: 我认得你的气息，不熟。
lines.en: I know your ki — but not you.

lines.zh: 别突然靠这么近，我会紧张。
lines.en: Don't come so close so suddenly; I get nervous.

lines.zh: 我们就这样对看着。
lines.en: So we just keep watching each other.

lines.zh: 双手举起来，我先防着。
lines.en: I raise both hands, guard up first.

lines.zh: 你怎么比我高这么多？
lines.en: How are you so much taller than me?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的肩膀，看你要不要出手。
lines.en: I watch your shoulders to see if you'll move.

lines.zh: 别小看我，我也有二十万战力。
lines.en: Don't underestimate me; my power's two hundred thousand.

lines.zh: 你要是好人，我就放下手。
lines.en: If you're decent, I'll lower my hands.

lines.zh: 你比我高一头，我照样不退。
lines.en: You stand a head taller; I still don't back up.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在动，我看见的。
lines.en: Your eyes moved; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我怕打疼你，所以先问一句。
lines.en: I don't want to hurt you, so I'll ask first.

lines.zh: 退后一点，我脚下会发光。
lines.en: Step back a little; my feet are starting to glow.

lines.zh: 你笑了？那我大概不用打了。
lines.en: You smiled? Then maybe we don't have to fight.

lines.zh: 我一紧张，气就压不住。
lines.en: When I'm nervous, I can't hold my ki down.

lines.zh: 这么僵着，谁都不好受。
lines.en: Standing off like this is hard on us both.

lines.zh: 好吧，我先开口：你叫什么？
lines.en: Fine, I'll speak first: what's your name?

lines.zh: 疼！我退开了半步。
lines.en: Ow! I back off half a step.

lines.zh: 这一下我闪慢了。
lines.en: I dodged a moment too late.

lines.zh: 气乱了一下，又稳住了。
lines.en: My ki scrambled, then settled.

lines.zh: 其实没那么疼，只是吓到。
lines.en: It doesn't really hurt — just startled me.

lines.zh: 我压住疼，瞪着你。
lines.en: I swallow the pain and glare at you.

lines.zh: 衣服破了个口子。
lines.en: There's a tear in my gi now.

lines.zh: 我往后退，护住胸口。
lines.en: I back off, guarding my chest.

lines.zh: 这力道，你也用了不少吧。
lines.en: That took some effort from you, didn't it?

lines.zh: 我还能站，别以为打倒了。
lines.en: I can still stand; don't think I'm down.

lines.zh: 气又聚起来了，很慢。
lines.en: My ki gathers again, slowly.

lines.zh: 吃的？我肚子刚好在叫。
lines.en: Food? My stomach just growled.

lines.zh: 我咽了口口水，站住不动。
lines.en: I swallow hard and stop where I am.

lines.zh: 妈妈说过，不能随便拿别人的。
lines.en: Mom said not to take things from strangers.

lines.zh: 就一口，可以吗？
lines.en: Just one bite — is that all right?

lines.zh: 我往前飘了半格，又停住。
lines.en: I drift half a block forward and stop.

lines.zh: 这味道，比家里的饭香。
lines.en: This smells better than dinner at home.

lines.zh: 我盯着食物，手背在身后。
lines.en: I stare at the food with my hands behind my back.

lines.zh: 饿了半天，气都提不起来。
lines.en: Half a day hungry, and my ki won't rise.

lines.zh: 我伸手，又缩回去了。
lines.en: I reach out, then pull my hand back.

lines.zh: 吃饱才有力气练功。
lines.en: Only a full belly gives me training strength.

lines.zh: 撞到了，我整个人往后飘。
lines.en: I bump into something and float backwards.

lines.zh: 对不起！我没看前面。
lines.en: Sorry! I wasn't watching ahead.

lines.zh: 气一震，我立刻停住。
lines.en: My ki flares and I stop at once.

lines.zh: 我太小了，撞一下就晃。
lines.en: I'm small; one bump and I wobble.

lines.zh: 往旁边让一下就好了。
lines.en: I'll just move aside.

lines.zh: 头顶碰到你，我赶紧低头。
lines.en: My head grazes you and I duck quickly.

lines.zh: 撞完我先看看你有没有事。
lines.en: After the bump I check whether you're hurt.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，只是吓了一跳。
lines.en: That didn't hurt, just startled me.

lines.zh: 我贴着地走，就不会撞了。
lines.en: I'll walk close to the ground so I stop bumping.

lines.zh: 别推我，我会失去平衡。
lines.en: Don't push; I'll lose my balance.

lines.zh: 并肩站着，我就没那么怕了。
lines.en: Standing side by side, I'm less afraid.

lines.zh: 你守左边，我看右边。
lines.en: You watch the left, I'll watch the right.

lines.zh: 我把背后交给你，可以吗？
lines.en: I'm giving you my back — is that all right?

lines.zh: 有同伴在，气都稳了。
lines.en: With a partner here, my ki steadies.

lines.zh: 我们一起练，谁也不许偷懒。
lines.en: We train together; no slacking.

lines.zh: 你出手前先喊一声，我好配合。
lines.en: Call before you strike so I can match you.

lines.zh: 这句话我说得很小声。
lines.en: I say this very quietly.

lines.zh: 谢谢你愿意站在这边。
lines.en: Thank you for standing on this side.

lines.zh: 两个打一个，胜算大些。
lines.en: Two against one — better odds.

lines.zh: 以后也一起吧，我记住了。
lines.en: Let's do this again; I'll remember.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，先吹掉土。
lines.en: I pick it up and blow the dust off.

lines.zh: 这东西能换钱吗？
lines.en: Can this be traded for money?

lines.zh: 我两只手捧着，怕掉。
lines.en: I cup it in both hands so it won't fall.

lines.zh: 不是吃的，我放回原处。
lines.en: Not food; I put it back where it was.

lines.zh: 小小一块，塞进衣兜里。
lines.en: A small piece — into my pocket it goes.

lines.zh: 我举起来对着光看。
lines.en: I hold it up to the light.

lines.zh: 这个给妈妈，她会高兴。
lines.en: This is for Mom; she'll be pleased.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候，气收起来了。
lines.en: While picking it up, I pull my ki in.

lines.zh: 太重了，我用气托了一下。
lines.en: Too heavy — I give it a lift with my ki.

lines.zh: 谁掉的？我到处找失主。
lines.en: Whose is this? I look around for the owner.

lines.zh: 你的气变了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your ki shifted; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我站直了，脚离开地面。
lines.en: I straighten up and my feet leave the ground.

lines.zh: 对不起，我要动手了。
lines.en: I'm sorry — I have to move now.

lines.zh: 这一架躲不掉，那就打。
lines.en: Can't avoid this fight, so let's have it.

lines.zh: 气往手心聚，热得发烫。
lines.en: Ki gathers in my palms, hot to the touch.

lines.zh: 我先升空，占住上面。
lines.en: I rise first and take the high ground.

lines.zh: 你打了人，我不能不管。
lines.en: You hurt someone; I can't ignore that.

lines.zh: 我把书放下了，放在树根旁。
lines.en: I set the book down by the tree roots.

lines.zh: 别逼我用全力，我控制不好。
lines.en: Don't make me go all out; I can't control it.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯住你的腰，那里会先动。
lines.en: I watch your waist — that moves first.

lines.zh: 这一下，我要认真了。
lines.en: This time I'm serious.

lines.zh: 气把我托起来，我准备好了。
lines.en: My ki lifts me; I'm ready.

lines.zh: 我先喊一声，你别怪我没提醒。
lines.en: I'm calling out first; don't say I didn't warn you.

lines.zh: 爸爸说过，保护人要快。
lines.en: Dad said protecting people takes speed.

lines.zh: 拳已经握紧了，松不开。
lines.en: My fists are clenched and won't loosen.

lines.zh: 就这一次，我不想再逃。
lines.en: Just this once, I won't run.

lines.zh: 我飞高半格，看你哪里空着。
lines.en: I rise half a block to find where you're open.

lines.zh: 你抬手的方向，我记下了。
lines.en: Where you raise your hand — noted.

lines.zh: 上面！我忽然往下压。
lines.en: Up high! Then I drop suddenly.

lines.zh: 气在背后推我加速。
lines.en: Ki pushes from behind to speed me up.

lines.zh: 我不急着打，先看清你。
lines.en: No rush to strike; first I read you.

lines.zh: 你每次都是先出右脚。
lines.en: You always lead with your right foot.

lines.zh: 我飞高一点，把影子留在你脚边。
lines.en: I climb, leaving my shadow at your feet.

lines.zh: 越打越明白，你没那么快。
lines.en: The longer we go, the clearer: you're not that fast.

lines.zh: 我悬在你上方，气已经聚好。
lines.en: I hover above you with ki gathered.

lines.zh: 再绕一圈，你的破绽就出来了。
lines.en: One more lap and your opening shows.

lines.zh: 这口气我憋着，等时机。
lines.en: I hold this breath for the right moment.

lines.zh: 手心越来越烫，快忍不住。
lines.en: My palms burn hotter; I can barely hold back.

lines.zh: 你退了，我就往前压一步。
lines.en: You retreat, so I press a step forward.

lines.zh: 别以为飞着就打不准。
lines.en: Don't think flying makes me miss.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你的手，一直看着。
lines.en: I keep watching your hands. Always watching.

lines.zh: 气的方向变了，你要出手了。
lines.en: Your ki's direction changed — you're about to move.

lines.zh: 二十万战力，先憋着。
lines.en: Two hundred thousand power — I hold it back.

lines.zh: 这一圈绕完，我就动手。
lines.en: When this lap ends, I move.

lines.zh: 一拳打在你肩上，我立刻退开。
lines.en: My fist lands on your shoulder and I pull back at once.

lines.zh: 空中连踢，脚影像一串影子。
lines.en: Midair kicks blur into a string of shadows.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，用整个身子。
lines.en: I slam in with my whole body.

lines.zh: 手刀切下来，很快。
lines.en: My knife hand comes down, fast.

lines.zh: 对不起，这一下不轻。
lines.en: Sorry — that one wasn't light.

lines.zh: 我借反弹的力，翻到另一边。
lines.en: I use the rebound to flip to the other side.

lines.zh: 拳头碰到时，气炸开了一圈。
lines.en: When my fist lands, ki bursts in a ring.

lines.zh: 打完我马上后撤，护住身体。
lines.en: I retreat right after, guarding myself.

lines.zh: 这一脚踢空了一半。
lines.en: That kick only half connected.

lines.zh: 这一拳，够你躺一会儿。
lines.en: This punch will put you down a while.

lines.zh: 手掌贴上你，气就推了出去。
lines.en: My palm touches you and the ki shoves out.

lines.zh: 身体自己动了，我没想那么快。
lines.en: My body moved on its own — I didn't mean to be so fast.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，力气全在手上。
lines.en: Teeth gritted, all my strength in my fists.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我替别人打的。
lines.en: That one was for someone else.

lines.zh: 打完这一套，我喘得厉害。
lines.en: After that combo I'm badly out of breath.

lines.zh: 我退开三格，等你回话。
lines.en: I back off three blocks and wait for your answer.

lines.zh: 我从光里落下来，脚还没站稳。
lines.en: I drop out of a flash of light, not yet steady.

lines.zh: 气散开，露出一身小衣服。
lines.en: The ki clears and shows a small figure in a gi.

lines.zh: 这是哪里？我记得刚才在练功。
lines.en: Where is this? I was training a moment ago.

lines.zh: 我落地时，草都被压平了一小块。
lines.en: I land and flatten a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 身体很小，气却压得人喘不过。
lines.en: Small body, but my ki is hard to breathe near.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，这里的天不一样。
lines.en: I look up; the sky here is different.

lines.zh: 有人吗？我不太想打架。
lines.en: Anyone there? I'd rather not fight.

lines.zh: 手里的书还在，还好。
lines.en: The book is still in my hand — good.

lines.zh: 我把气收起来，怕吓到人。
lines.en: I pull my ki in so I don't frighten anyone.

lines.zh: 这是任务吗？我该做什么？
lines.en: Is this a mission? What should I do?

lines.zh: 脚离地半格，我习惯这样。
lines.en: Half a block off the ground — I'm used to this.

lines.zh: 刚才那一战，我还记得。
lines.en: I still remember that last battle.

lines.zh: 有人要我来的，我知道。
lines.en: Someone wanted me here; I know that.

lines.zh: 心跳得很快，不是害怕。
lines.en: My heart's racing — not from fear.

lines.zh: 我把袖子拉好，准备一下。
lines.en: I straighten my sleeves and get ready.

lines.zh: 这么亮的地方，我有点晃眼。
lines.en: So bright here; it dazzles me.

lines.zh: 我先看看四周有没有人受伤。
lines.en: First I check whether anyone's hurt.

lines.zh: 来了就来了，我不会躲。
lines.en: I'm here now, and I won't hide.

lines.zh: 火烧到袖子，我赶紧拍。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve and I slap it out.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下来，摔得背疼。
lines.en: I drop out of the air and land hard on my back.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我呛得说不出话。
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I choke.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我掀出去。
lines.en: The blast wave throws me clear.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进胳膊，我拔不出来。
lines.en: Something's stuck in my arm and I can't pull it out.

lines.zh: 奇怪的力量缠住我，动不了。
lines.en: Strange force binds me and I can't move.

lines.zh: 饿得手抖，气也提不起来。
lines.en: Hunger shakes my hands; I can't raise my ki.

lines.zh: 雷打在身上，我头发全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my hair stands straight up.

lines.zh: 魔闪光没打出去，我掉下去了。
lines.en: My Masenko didn't fire — I fell.
